content.prompt: This data shows the minimum temperatures at Mount Buller on 10 days.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How many days had a temperature below $-10^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$?

answer.worked: The temperatures below $-10^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ are $-25,-20,-19,-16,-11,-11^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$. There are 6 days.

children.label: b
children.prompt: How many days had a temperature between $-12^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ and $3^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$?

answer.worked: The temperatures in this interval are $-11,-11,-7,-3,2^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$. There are 5 days.
